blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative three times negative two, squared, minus four times the quantity five minus eight, minus negative nine.
Parentheses first. Five minus eight is negative three.
Next, the exponent. Negative two, squared, is four.
Now the multiplications. Negative three times four is negative twelve.
Four times negative three is also negative twelve.
Left to right. Negative twelve minus negative twelve is the same as negative twelve plus twelve, which is zero.
Finally, zero minus negative nine is zero plus nine. That's nine.
Watch out for these traps. If you square the whole product, you get fifty-seven. If you multiply the four by only the five, you get negative thirty-one.
